scope: Retrospective benchmark with documented nominal release bounds; not certified historical operational replay.
primary_eligible_period: Value-complete days 2024-01-28..2025-12-31 minus declared advisory dependencies; no outcome-based period choice.
target: P(D+1), local 00..24; hourly mean at fixed ADS point.
PM: P(d) from run d-1 12 UTC, leads5..28; P(D-1)..P(D-k).
weather: Previous_day1 forecast values aggregated on local days D-1..D-k, with rain intervals assigned by their start.
fire: GFAS UTC mean days D-2..D-(k+1); density-based mean power and positive-analysis-area fraction, not hotspot count.
nominal_bounds: CAMS12 UTC by22 UTC; GFAS day s by(s+1)07 UTC; weather fixed24h offset metadata. Exceptions remain explicit.
quarantine: Any target, PM/weather history or GFAS input whose relevant native valid dates overlap9..14Aug2024 is flagged conservatively before fitting; source-to-target dependency ledger controls exclusions.
split_rationale: Whole calendar2025 test includes all seasons; validation2024Q4; earlier training. Boundary labels2024Sep30/Dec31 not yet mature before next phase and are purged.
selection: Training-only chronological CV; primary Ridge group/window selected only on validation. HGB secondary; never promote the best test setting.
rationale_for_retrospective_execution: New native runs and complete values permit a truthful retrospective source-clock comparison; unresolved availability is not converted into a PASS or fabricated timestamp.
preserved: Baseline algorithms/grids, scaling pipeline, warning threshold, bootstrap design, four-notebook structure and report styles; only incompatible source/time/quality dependencies change.
